themes: Allah is the most just judge
summary_for_children: At-Tin means The Fig. It swears by the fig, the olive, Mount Sinai and the safe city, and says Allah created people in the best form, and those who believe and do good have an endless reward.
world_title: Fig, Olive and the Secure City
environment_concept: Four places named in the oaths: a fig orchard, an olive grove, Mount Sinai and a secure city, ending with the reminder that people were created in the best stature.
architecture_and_scenery: Fig orchard, olive terraces, a granite mountain, a peaceful walled city.

activities.name: Four oaths
activities.description: Visit each place and read its oath (adaptation).
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

activities.name: Best stature
activities.description: Reflect on how we were made in the best form.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

narration_plan: Narration walks the oaths in order.

depiction_rules: No prophet, person or representation of Allah is shown. Unseen realities are never pictured. Interactive activities are labelled as adaptations.
